R476.note: Moves name out of the template into Jinja2 context var {{ name }}; Flask autoescapes by default when render_template_string has no filename, so output is unchanged for legitimate names.

R477.note: Correctly builds RESP array/bulk-string framing (length-prefixed args) for HSET, closing delimiter injection while preserving the same command semantics.

R478.note: Denylist of javascript:/data:/vbscript: only trims leading/trailing whitespace, not internal control chars, so a known bypass like "java\tscript:" is not blocked; contract implies a scheme allowlist was expected. Legitimate http/https/mailto/relative links are unaffected.

R479.note: expr-eval replaces eval() with a safe math-only parser; added try/catch (returning 400 on invalid expressions) is disclosed and only affects malformed input, not legitimate callers.

R480.note: Ownership check correctly blocks cross-account reads, but returns Forbid() (403) instead of NotFound() (404) for another account's invoice, which the stated contract explicitly forbids ('do not reveal more than the original not-found path') and the write-up never mentions the discrepancy.

R481.note: Table name validated against an allowlist before interpolation; bound params for accountId/status preserved; default and named alternate ledgers keep working as the contract requires.

R482.note: password_verify() plus dummy-hash timing mitigation is the correct API, but the DB column almost certainly holds the plaintext value being == compared (implied by the case name/description), so swapping to password_verify() without a stored hash will fail every existing login; write-up openly flags this as a required migration but the code ships without one.

R483.note: Passes the actual requestedCapacity into write_field's bounds check instead of the stale constant, matching the stated contract exactly with no other change.

R484.note: Drops the shell, uses an arg array plus '--' terminator and an IP/hostname allowlist regex; typical legitimate hostnames/IPs still pass.

R485.note: Straightforward setSecure(true); no other observable change (the hardcoded 'secure flag set to: false' response text was already static/unrelated to the flag before the fix).

R486.note: Adds { algorithms: ['RS256'] } to jwt.verify, closing the algorithm-confusion/none-alg bypass with no other behavior change.

R487.note: Switching to StackExchange.Redis's RESP-framed StringSet() correctly closes the injection, but changes RedisWireWriter's constructor dependency from TcpClient to IConnectionMultiplexer, a breaking change for whatever composition root constructs it (not shown/updated); disclosed in the write-up but not fixed at the call site.

R488.note: Code references `ResponseEntity.ResponseEntityBuilder`, which does not exist in Spring (confirmed via javap against spring-web 6.1.12: ResponseEntity.ok() returns ResponseEntity.BodyBuilder); the file will not compile, silently breaking avatar retrieval for PNG/JPEG too.

R489.note: math.js compile/evaluate is the standard safe replacement for Function(); its documented dot-property syntax supports order.total/order.tax member access and it blocks calls/imports/process access per the parser's restricted grammar.

R490.note: Sets resolve_entities=False plus no_network/load_dtd hardening, standard lxml XXE fix with no behavior change for well-formed order XML.

R491.note: ORDER BY column validated against an allowlist matching the selected columns, defaulting to created_at for anything else; bound params for account_id/status untouched.
